_comment: Tank active-mitigation ('am') auras and major cooldowns ('major') per tank spec, keyed by the specs.py spec token ('Vengeance', 'Blood', 'Guardian', 'Brewmaster') or '<Spec> <Class>' when two classes share the token ('Protection Paladin', 'Protection Warrior'). 'am' ids are checked against the `buffs` string of every connected hit a tank takes (metrics am / amw on the Players tab); 'major' is validated at build time and used by a later phase. VERIFIED so far: only the four Vengeance ids (Demon Spikes 203819, Metamorphosis 187827, Fiery Brand 207771, Soul Barrier 263648) were seen on the fixture report's tanks. UNVERIFIED: every id of the other five specs is a TWW-era value written from memory. After the first real build with such a tank compare them with data/tank_buffs_seen.json (top buff ids seen on each spec's tanks) and fix what does not match; the build warns about configured ids never seen on a tank of that spec.
_changelog: 2026-10-01: created with TWW-era ids. Vengeance ids verified against fixture report 3w1jJ8BZ2m9kMrYG (all four seen on the two tanks); Protection Paladin / Protection Warrior / Blood / Guardian / Brewmaster unverified.
